meta.reasoning:
Preface chapter-agent pass complete. Verdict is 'needs another pass', not penultimate: three of five gates pass (actionable, cited, texture) and two fail (cohesion, voice), and both failures are judgment calls the primer reserves to CT.

What changed: three prose fixes, all factual rather than stylistic. sts.preface.b0003 ASIMO caption now separates the 2001 model year from the 2023 photograph date, closing a licence contradiction (CC BY-SA 4.0 did not exist until 2013). sts.preface.b0011 'Look back 100 years' became 'Look back across the last 100 years', because read as a point in time it means 1926, which predates nuclear weapons by nineteen years and falls between the world wars, making two of its three clauses false. sts.preface.b0013 lost the false quantifier 'almost all'. Also synced art-catalog.json so its caption does not drift, appended the Hitchcock and Sheridan primary sources to Appendix B as 183 and 184, and wrote a full verification record to the research log. sts.py id verify passes: 2004 blocks, 0 duplicates, 83 art links, no bad links.

change is 0.35 rather than higher because the edits were deliberately narrow. That was the point: the largest defects found are ones I chose not to touch. The Preface's b0008 asserts that reframing your thinking is 'your first and most important tool' and that 'nothing can own your mind unless you allow it', which contradicts Chapter 5's watts-and-heat thesis, contradicts the Preface's own b0023 thirty lines later, and contradicts P-10 Torches of Freedom whose entire lesson is that desire can be manufactured without consent. That is the single highest-impact finding of the pass and it is CT's call, so it is reported, not executed.

Two things I did that were not in the plan. I verified the Introduction agent's open 'UNVERIFIED, print-rights exposure' item on the Atlas photo and found it clean (DARPA, public domain, 2013-07-11), closing it in the research log without editing their file. And I abandoned a planned 'decentralized energy' to 'distributed energy' change after grep showed Appendix A defines DERS as a term of art, so the Preface was already correct and my fix would have introduced divergence. Logged as a dead end.

Discipline gap to record honestly: my goals-create at PREFLIGHT did not persist (goals-list returns empty), so this transaction has no linked goal. I deliberately did not backfill one after the work, since a goal added retroactively is a self-graded checkbox rather than a tracked unit. The unknown about whether CT wants the Preface body cut is left open on purpose, because it is genuinely unresolved and awaits his ruling. Nothing was committed; the workspace rule is never auto-commit.
